parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button part of a retractable pen, typically made of durable plastic and located at the top of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip by pressing it, engaging an internal spring mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position due to the internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main cylindrical body of the pen, made of plastic, which houses the ink cartridge and provides grip for writing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the structural support for the pen, containing the ink refill and providing a comfortable surface for holding during writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main handle of the pen.
